name: com.luvikung.attributes
description: A collection of custom Unity inspector attributes for enforcing field validation and display rules directly in code.
author: Thanut Panichyotai

samples.description: A playable ball-rolling scene that demonstrates all three attributes in a real Inspector setup: [PrefabAsset] on spawnable prefab references, [NotNull] on required component lists, and [ReadOnly] for live tilt values visible during Play Mode.
